title: Rodchenkov Anti-Doping Act of 2019
official_summary:
Rodchenkov Anti-Doping Act of 2019

This bill makes it unlawful to knowingly influence (or attempt or conspire to influence) a major international sports competition by use of a prohibited substance or prohibited method.

A violator is subject to criminal penalties—a fine, a prison term of up to 10 years, or both—and mandatory restitution. Additionally, property may be seized and forfeited to the U.S. government if it was used or intended to be used to commit an offense or traceable to the proceeds in connection with an offense.

summary.headline: A federal law makes it a crime to knowingly use banned substances or methods to influence major international sports competitions.
summary.what_it_does: The law makes it illegal to knowingly influence, or try or plan to influence, a major international sports competition by using a prohibited substance or prohibited method. Anyone convicted can face a fine, up to 10 years in prison, or both, and must pay restitution. Property used in the offense, or traceable to its proceeds, can be seized and forfeited to the U.S. government.

who_it_affects.group: Athletes and coaches who take part in major international sporting events
who_it_affects.how: They could face criminal fines or prison if they knowingly use banned substances or methods to affect the outcome of a covered competition.

who_it_affects.group: Medical staff, trainers, and others who supply banned substances or methods to competitors
who_it_affects.how: They could be prosecuted, required to pay restitution, and have related property seized if they knowingly help influence a covered competition this way.

who_it_affects.group: People who own property connected to these offenses
who_it_affects.how: Property that was used, intended for use, or traceable to the proceeds of an offense can be taken and forfeited to the federal government.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 4, 2020, and its penalties apply to offenses covered by the act from that date forward.
